02809 Cheshbown {khesh-bone'}

與02808同; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Heshbon 38; 38

希實本 = "堡壘"
1) 亞摩利王西宏的首都, 位於高原西邊邊陲，在流便族與迦得族得邊界上
record.edic_text:
02809 Cheshbown {khesh-bone'}

the same as 02808;; n pr loc

AV - Heshbon 38; 38

Heshbon = "stronghold"
1) the capital city of Sihon, king of the Amorites, located on the
   western border of the high plain and on the border line between
   the tribes of Reuben and Gad
